speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) secondary to perinatal asphyxia. The clinical picture of preterm birth, chorioamnionitis, depressed Apgar scores, and acute onset of seizures with lethargy strongly points to HIE, likely exacerbated by the initial hypoxic event. Immediate management should focus on therapeutic hypothermia and supportive care.
